name: Barcode
description: Shows a Code 128 barcode for an id you supply -- a parkrun athlete id, a membership number, a transit pass. The id comes from your phone; the watch only draws it.

configFields.label: Your ID
configFields.description: The number printed under your barcode, copied exactly. Case matters.
configFields.validationMessage: 1 to 16 plain characters, exactly as printed.
